notes: Fixed a BEVCO invoice that would not read (its compressed data ended in a newline byte that was being trimmed off). BEVCO invoices: select a whole folder of PDFs at once. Each invoice is shown for the usual quick check and confirming moves straight to the next; an invoice that is already in the register is skipped, so nothing is counted twice. Also: Beverage Control has an All brands switch for typing a new month, and the period can be changed from any page.
